Select exact IC50 activity rows for the HDAC6 assay CHEMBL1865, requiring compounds with canonical SMILES and PubMed-indexed documents. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then docs, then activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1865', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
